Managing e-commerce returns is already enough of a headache for any growing brand. The last thing your business needs is more returns simply because of incorrect or incomplete address information. 

Every undeliverable package adds to lost sales, wasted shipping costs, and frustrated customers. That’s why the @United States Postal Service offers the USPS Address Verification API. 

By integrating this tool into your checkout process, you can validate and standardize addresses against our massive database in real-time. It catches typos, corrects ZIP codes (and adds ZIP+4 info), and even identifies whether an address is residential or commercial. The result: Packages get where they need to go on the first try, saving you money and improving your customer experience.
